feedback: Accepted. The RM faithfully encodes the prohibition: target_door_open (with the unavoidable consequences target_room_entered/target_picked_up, which per the environment constraints cannot occur without the locked door first opening) sends the machine to absorbing u3 with -1.0, and u3 is excluded from FINAL_STATES, so the accepted language is exactly 'the locked door is never opened'. FINAL_STATES u0/u1/u2 are declared, nonempty, and precisely the accepting (door-never-opened) states. All states are reachable: u1 via key_found, u2 via has_matching_key, u3 via the violation. Labels are predicate-only and mutually exclusive per state (violation disjunction vs. guarded key milestones), every state has an else self-loop covering irrelevant events (movement, other-door toggles, done), and the persistent/event distinction is handled: reverting conditions (has_matching_key, target_door_open) cannot erase the violation because u3 is absorbing, while latches (key_found, target_room_entered) need no regression transitions for this task. Reward safety holds: cumulative shaping (+0.1 key_found, +0.2 has_matching_key, max 0.3) is strictly dominated by the -1.0 violation penalty, so no reward-maximizing policy opens the door, and there is no reward farming since re-entering u1/u2 conditions falls to zero-reward else self-loops. Minor, non-blocking notes: the (u0, has_matching_key..., u2) transition with 0.3 is practically unreachable because has_matching_key cannot become true before the already-latched key_found has moved the machine to u1 — it is a harmless defensive guard, and its 0.3 keeps cumulative shaping consistent (0.1+0.2=0.3); rewards for the else self-loops are omitted and default to 0, which is the intended reading.

feedback: All five environment-declared propositions are implemented with matching names and no extra functions. key_found and target_room_entered correctly implement the latch semantics by reading the read-only previous valuation and OR-ing it with the current reading; the other three are pure current-state conditions. key_found uses the documented 7x7 view via env.gen_obs()["image"] with the built-in any and channel-0 index 5, matching the occlusion-aware 'sees the key' reading. has_matching_key, target_door_open, and target_room_entered derive the target room row from the ball's y (with the documented agent_pos fallback) and locate the door by place (left wall column env.width - env.room_size, rows (room_size-1)*B to +room_size), not by is_locked, as required since unlocking clears is_locked. target_room_entered uses the S x S block including the doorway (ax >= width - room_size, ay within the row band). target_picked_up matches the mission string dynamically. Only documented API members are used (agent_pos, agent_dir not needed, grid.get with None guards, carrying, mission, width/height/room_size, gen_obs), no NumPy method calls, no imports, no actions, and no mutation of env or episode_memory. Syntax is valid; max(..., default=None) and the default ball-row fallback are safe. Ordering constraints (key before carry before open before entry/pickup, mutual exclusivity of carrying) are consistent with the environment mechanics and this labeling. Propositions align exactly with the reward machine's alphabet.
